nodes.text:
#HumanMetapneumovirus (#HMPV) is a #virus causing #flu and lower respiratory tract infection symptoms such as bronchitis and #pneumonia in humans.

This virus can spread in all age groups but symptoms in healthy adults who have strong immunity are not serious in general.
